item.title: April in Progress
item.description:
Abril, the new typeface by Veronika Burian and José Scaglione is on the way. It is a font family engineered mainly for newspapers and magazines that features friendly and elegant styles for headlines and robust and economic styles for text. For the first time ever, we will be posting images showing the progress of the develoment of a font family. So stay connected to our Flickr group!

http://www.flickr.com/photos/typetogether/sets/72157623684586626/

item.title: Calligraphy Workshops with Julian Waters at Cooper Union
item.description:
Two more workshops are being offered at Cooper Union this spring in lettering: “Organic Capitals” April 17 & 18 and “Compressed Styles (Black letter)” May 1 & 2. To see complete workshop details www.cooper.edu/ce

These workshops are appropriate for people who have some background in lettering or calligraphy and are already
comfortable using a broad edged pen. Absolute beginners will struggle but if you’re up for the challenge Julian is an excellent teacher to begin with.
